# Mylo Kaye — Dynamics 365 Customer Insights tools

> A curated portfolio of open-source tools, prototypes and practical guidance for Dynamics 365 Customer Insights, forms and campaign operations.

Canonical site: https://mylokaye.me/
Author: Mylo Kaye
GitHub: https://github.com/mylokaye
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/mylo-kaye/
Full site context: https://mylokaye.me/llms-full.txt

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://mylokaye.me/): Overview of current Dynamics 365 and customer-experience projects.
- [About Mylo Kaye](https://mylokaye.me/about/): Professional focus, working approach and contact links.
- [Form Debugger for Dynamics 365](https://mylokaye.me/form-debugger/): Free Chrome and Edge extension for bypassing cache while testing Dynamics 365 Customer Insights forms. Current documented version: 1.3.0.
- [Form Studio](https://mylokaye.me/d365-form-skill/): Alpha Codex skill for restyling exported Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Journeys forms while preserving original fields and behaviour. Current documented version: 1.1.0.
- [Pattens](https://mylokaye.me/pattens/): Privacy-focused campaign-operations toolkit for planning, naming and UTM workflows.
- [Agentic Form](https://mylokaye.me/agentic-form/): Two-step inquiry-form prototype with validation, optional company enrichment, and local-only prototype submission.
- [VS HTML Preview](https://mylokaye.me/html-preview/): VS Code extension for live HTML previews with responsive viewports, asset refresh, diagnostics, and GitHub workspace support. Current published version: 0.1.5. [Marketplace](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=MyloKaye.vs-html-preview) · [Source](https://github.com/mylokaye/html-preview).
- [Foundations Agent Plugin Library](https://mylokaye.me/foundations/): Portable plugins for project delivery, plugin authoring, web development, and JavaScript static review. Fresh-client installation checks and catalog publication are pending. [Source](https://github.com/mylokaye/Foundations).
- [Privacy](https://mylokaye.me/privacy.html): Data handling for this website and the Form Debugger extension.
